title: Cross
subtitle: A beautiful strike. These flames always hit their mark.

trails.title: Uluru Desert
trails.description: Her guidance came from that which she had awakened long ago, and her protection came from that which she had once saved.

trails.title: The Torch Guardians II
trails.description: The torch relay comes to a halt here. The flickering flames have enraged the filth beneath the riverbed.

items.text: Lakeside Garden

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Is this the Laplace fashion of dealing with emergencies?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I swear, if anyone walks past us now, schoolers or derros, I will be instantly killed by their silent judgment.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: As a matter of fact, when the patient or the subject becomes unstable during contact, it is necessary to isolate them from the triggering cause immediately.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: But, we just burnt down the isolation room.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: No wonder Head Nurse Judith was so angry.

items.speaker: Kangaroo
items.text: URAGH!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms. Vertin, are you alright?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: That kangaroo is ... punching your nose.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm fine.

items.speaker: Kangaroo
items.text: URAGH!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So is the kangaroo.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm sure Medicine Pocket will bring us the Concentration Potion soon.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: They'd better. We look like a bunch of kangaroos, feel like kangaroos, and even smell like kangaroos!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: We will make tomorrow's headline of Australian Nagger and become "the three kangaroos hanging out on a public lawn at midnight." That'd be the end of our social lives as humans and the beginning of a life as kangaroos.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Make the headline? Aah, I see. Please don't worry.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Although it's true that Medicine Pocket is a frequent celebrity on the news, the Concentration Potion is not their work. Besides, we didn't use anything new in its development ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I'm not worried about that guy. I was talking about myself. There are paparazzi following me around these days.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I didn't know you were famous.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I'm not. It's just that someone wants my name spread in a bad way. Trust me, you should never piss off the paparazzi.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: You should turn to the police for help.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Yeah yeah, just shut up and keep your eyes peeled for anything suspicious.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I will toss his shoes on the power lines, if I found him here.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Ms. Desert Flannel, watch your back!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: What, are those paparaz- ... Aaah, waaaah! It burns!
The young girl leaps to her feet, letting out a scream as the bench beneath her turned scorching hot.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Is this ... fire? Ms. Desert Flannel, the lake is over there! Get in there!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Lake? I ... I can't swim!

items.speaker: Kangaroo
items.text: URAAGH!AHHH!!
There are people shouting, feet running, sparks flying.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Aaah! This stupid kangaroo kicked me in the eye, ouch! Move, move! I can't see where the lake is!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait, calm down!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You are not in danger. She is.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Are you joking?! I was getting burned. Emm? There's nothing on my skin.
The unwanted visitor stands in front of them, panting as if she's burning from her body temperature.
Her golden reflection sways in water like real flames.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: *deep breath*

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Race.
The burning flame bounces from Desert Flannel to Ezra.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: It didn't cause any damage on me, just burning the foam on my skin. Is that some new method developed to get rid of the potion?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: But what is Ms. Spathodea doing here? The head nurse shouldn't have let an unstable patient walk around freely. Did, did she sneak out?!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Gosh! Mate, she's on fire! Does she even remotely look stable to you?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Race, like a deor ... stepping on the red soil where vines and woods grow ...
The glare and heat rush through her, like waves.
Spathodea, engulfed in flame, approaches Desert Flannel, with fiery eyes, mouth, heart, and body, and takes her into her arms.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Urrah!

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Aah, f**k me dead! She's as well heated as a boiling pot! We can't let her go on like this! Her brain is going to be roasted in that little head!
Desert Flannel strives to get out of her control, patting Spathodea on the cheeks with her cold hands.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Let go, Spathodea! Your temperature is dangerously high. Chill out!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: I'm not ... a lizard ... and ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Concrete No. 2 with cream is the best dish and pipe material!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Spathodea is suffering confusion. It's probably the flame's doing.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We need to separate them first.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Okay ... okay! Ms. Vertin, please step back!
A mist with the color of turquoise blows toward the girls.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Oi! What are you sprayin- ...?! I'm still here! Hey!
Soon, both Desert Flannel's complaints and Spathodea's sleep talk quiet down.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: This is just some spores, Ms. Desert Flannel, worry not.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: They are the tranquilizer that the locals used to pacify animals and was once widely used among arcanists in early times for hunting.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: As long as we calm her down, we can bring her back to ... Whooaa!
However, that fireball girl hits everyone in front of her like knocking down all the pins in a row.
A perfect bowling strike.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Games ... Games! Games! We need the real Games!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: This is where sportsmanship originates ... Young people, young ... people ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Young people need cats! And strawberry ja- ... jam! Cat jam it is!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Did I use the wrong mushroom? Ms. Spathodea has become even more restless!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: What about Ms. Desert Flannel? Is she ...
Ezra manages to get up, looking at the turquoise green mist without dusting himself off.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, you didn't. She's behaving exactly the way you described.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Aah ... Ms. ... Desert Flannel?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: ... Heh-heh.
Their fierce friend, with a smile on her face, is rolling on the ground like a cat getting high on catmints.
She keeps reaching her hands to the sky as if she is trying to catch something.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Is this ... the house for me? Heh heh, oh ... Haha ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Does this mean I don't have to ... pay rent anymore? Heh heh ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Looks like this is how she has her mental break.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I will bring her back to normal immediately. It won't take mo-more than five minutes. But I think Ms. Spathodea is going to attack again!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: What ye need is the reopening of the gate to the scorching land, and ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: And ... the retrieval of the rock ... Ugh ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: And her fire is getting stronger ... Get down!
The moment they duck, the scorching hot fire flies over the top of their heads.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We are running out of time. Let's deal with the burning issue first.
Taking a deep breath, Ezra grabs the straps even tighter.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I will! I will try my best!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Ugh, where am I?

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: What are you doing here, guys? I thought you were driven away?

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Great, she's back to normal!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Oh ... I remember it now ...
Spathodea can't maintain her balance and falls to the ground.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Spathodea!

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: The Games ...
She raises one arm with all her strength and grasps the cuff of the girl standing in front of her.

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: We must revive ... the Uluru Games ...

items.speaker: Spathodea
items.text: Because ... the rocks, rumble on the knees ...

items.speaker: Medical Staff
items.text: I've heard what's going on.

items.speaker: Medical Staff
items.text: We will check if her organs are injured by the high temperature after returning to Laplace. You can visit her tomorrow after 11:00 a.m.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Emm? Can we visit her? I thought you would send her to the wards on the 13th floor.

items.speaker: Medical Staff
items.text: Go with the flow when you can't fight it.

items.speaker: Medical Staff
items.text: We've now understood what will happen if we separate you and keep her alone some place else. What's more, Laplace can't lose another clinic.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: I see, this is great! Thank you!
The white ambulance drives away from the street.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: So, are you sure those mushrooms won't cause any damage to my brain and body?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Like lower IQ levels, lung diseases, or skin allergy ...

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Emm. If you think it's necessary, I will accompany you to Laplace for some follow-up check-ups!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Of course, you don't have to pay for the tests. The fee will be deducted from my salary. Please don't worry about the money.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Okay okay! Enough! I trust you! I don't need a kid to pay the doctor for me. Besides ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: It's embarrassing enough to be put down by mushrooms, not to mention that I'll be giving that guy the story they carved if I was hospitalized.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: "That guy"? Ah, you mean, the journalist following you.

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Emm ...

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Was that a flash?! Speak of the devil ... B****r!
Silently cursing, Desert Flannel scans the bush in the dark with a serious look on her face.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Come out yourself. Don't make me force you!
The bush rustles. Seconds later, a man stands up. His black shirt indistinguishable from the darkness, making his face appear as if it were floating in the air.
Heh.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: Makower, don't you dare involve others. This is between you and me.

items.speaker: Makower
items.text: I've told you long ago that one day I will make you feel the same misery that I did. I've been following you all the time, and this is the moment, the moment of vengeance!

items.speaker: Makower
items.text: Heh-heh, now, I have more than enough photos.

items.speaker: Makower
items.text: As for these "other people" ... You didn't strike me as such a kind-hearted person.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: I didn't know you are so shameless!

items.speaker: Makower
items.text: Let's see what tomorrow's newspaper has to say about this, Ms. Photographer.
A hideous smile forms on that floating face. Makower then disappears in the shadow.

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: No, we can't let him get away. He has a photo of us!

items.speaker: Ezra
items.text: Is he your enemy ... emm, maybe archenemy? What happened between you two?

items.speaker: Desert Flannel
items.text: If you don't wanna be one of the "burning kangaroos" on the headline tomorrow, shut up and start running!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We have to stop him.
